val sum_cont = Val[Int]
val peak_hospit = Val[Int]
val hour_school_missed = Val[Int]
val hospit_days_upper_threshold = Val[Int]
val asymp_0_2 = Val[Double]
val asymp_3_5 = Val[Double]
val asymp_6_10 = Val[Double]
val asymp_11_17 = Val[Double]
val asymp_18_24 = Val[Double]
val asymp_25_39 = Val[Double]
val asymp_40_54 = Val[Double]
val asymp_55_64 = Val[Double]
val asymp_65_79 = Val[Double]
val asymp_80p = Val[Double]
val selflockedin = Val[Double]
val escape_test = Val[Double]
val false_negative = Val[Double]
val mySeed = Val[Long]
val arr = Val[String]
val cont_factor = Val[Double]

val juliaTask =
  JuliaTask(workDirectory / "ici_simulateur.jl" / "src" / "exec" / "mainOMsensitivity.jl",
  version = "1.12.7",
  libraries = Seq("DelimitedFiles", "DataStructures", "Serd","Distributions","LinearAlgebra","Random","StatsBase", "TimerOutputs", "JSON")
  ) set(
    resources += (workDirectory / "ici_simulateur.jl" / "src" , link = true),
    resources += (workDirectory / "ici_simulateur.jl" / "data", link = true),
    arr := "75105",
    cont_factor:= 0.0403973588180338,
    outputs += peak_hospit.mapped,
//    outputs += hour_school_missed.mapped,
//    outputs += sum_cont.mapped,
    outputs += hospit_days_upper_threshold.mapped,
    inputs += arr.mapped,
    inputs += cont_factor.mapped,
    inputs += asymp_0_2.mapped,
    inputs += asymp_3_5.mapped ,
    inputs += asymp_6_10.mapped ,
    inputs += asymp_11_17.mapped ,
    inputs += asymp_18_24.mapped ,
    inputs += asymp_25_39.mapped ,
    inputs += asymp_40_54.mapped ,
    inputs += asymp_55_64.mapped ,
    inputs += asymp_65_79.mapped ,
    inputs += asymp_80p.mapped ,
    inputs += selflockedin.mapped ,
    inputs += escape_test.mapped ,
    inputs += false_negative.mapped
  )
val env = LocalEnvironment(2)
//val h = CSVHook(workDirectory / "Res" / "nbcont.csv",values = nb_cont)
val miniclust = MiniClustEnvironment(
    "mcolomb",
    "https://babar.openmole.org",
    core = 1//,
//    time = 4000
)
  
val margaret = SLURMEnvironment(
    "mcolomb",
    "localhost",
    port = 2220,
    workDirectory = "/scratch/mcolomb/.tmp",
    sharedDirectory = "/scratch/mcolomb/.openmole/.tmp/",
    time = 24 hour,
    memory = 4 gigabytes,
    modules = Seq("singularity"),
    nodes = 1
)

val pse = PPSEEvolution(
  evaluation = juliaTask,
  parallelism = 1000,
  termination = 500000,
//  termination = 10000,
  genome = Seq(
    asymp_0_2 in (0.05, 0.8),
    asymp_3_5 in (0.05, 0.8),
    asymp_6_10 in (0.05, 0.8),
    asymp_11_17 in (0.05, 0.8),
    asymp_18_24 in (0.05, 0.8),
    asymp_25_39 in (0.05, 0.8),
    asymp_40_54 in (0.05, 0.8),
    asymp_55_64 in (0.05, 0.8),
    asymp_65_79 in (0.05, 0.8),
    asymp_80p in (0.05, 0.8),
    selflockedin in (0.4, 1.0),
    escape_test in (0.05, 0.5),
    false_negative in (0.05, 0.5)
  ),
  density = Seq(
    asymp_0_2 in NormalDistribution(0.5, 0.1),
    asymp_3_5 in NormalDistribution(0.5, 0.1),
    asymp_6_10 in NormalDistribution(0.5, 0.1),
    asymp_11_17 in NormalDistribution(0.5, 0.1),
    asymp_18_24 in NormalDistribution(0.3, 0.1),
    asymp_25_39 in NormalDistribution(0.3, 0.1),
    asymp_40_54 in NormalDistribution(0.3, 0.1),
    asymp_55_64 in NormalDistribution(0.3, 0.1),
    asymp_65_79 in NormalDistribution(0.2, 0.1),
    asymp_80p in NormalDistribution(0.2, 0.1),
    false_negative in NormalDistribution(0.1,0.1),
  ),
  objective = Seq(
//    sum_cont in (20000 to 35000 by 500), //30 cells
    peak_hospit in (30 to 230 by 4), // 50 cells - lockdown3
    hospit_days_upper_threshold in (0 to 60 by 1) // 60 cells
//    hour_school_missed in (80000 to 360000 by 10000) //28 cells
  ),
  maxRareSample = 100,
  nicheSize = 10,
  gmmTolerance = 0.0001,
  dilation = 2.0,
  minDensityQuantile = 0.2,
  densitySample = 2000,
  bootstrap = 5000,
  stochastic = Stochastic(seed = mySeed)
) hook (workDirectory / "PPSE-5th-HardLockdown3-20260919_tset_niche") by SteadyState(elitismBy = 100)

pse on miniclust
